description: Full LIST of open jobs at one company (up to 500), newest first, read live from its public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee job board. Use this when you need the actual postings: to read, filter or export them, find a role to apply to, or pull salaries. For counts and hiring trends use hiring_signals instead. Input: company (website domain, website URL or job-board URL); optional keywords (title contains any), remote (true = remote only) and limit (1-500, default 100). Returns company, domain, found, boards, summary, count, totalMatching and results[]: one job each with title, department, location, remote flag, posted date, apply URL, salary when the employer publishes it, function and seniority. found=false (empty results) means no supported public board was found. Limits: one company per call; answers cached for 1 hour; 20 free companies a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored or sent.

company.description: The company, one per call: its website domain, website URL, or a job-board URL (boards.greenhouse.io/acme, jobs.lever.co/acme, jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme)

keywords.description: Optional job-title keywords; a job matches if its title contains any of them

remote.description: true = remote roles only (default false: all roles)

name: company_jobs
title: Open jobs at a company
